text:
ellie_sales: Heads-up: Merlin Catalyst (customer POC) wants to test their custom v1-quant variant. Do we have compatibility notes? They care about KMS BYOK and canary traffic. cc @jordan_se

jordan_se: We haven't validated v1-quant yet. Main issues we've seen with other 4-bit variants: tokenizer mismatch, KV cache layout differences — can break prefix caching. Need a model manifest + tokenizer to be sure.

mira_ml: If it's a standard BPE/byte-level variant we can shim tokenization. Ask for tokenizer.json + merges/vocab. Also would like a tiny weights tar to validate quant kernels.

tomas_ops: KMS/BYOK: supported on Private and Dedicated (customer CMK via KMS/HSM). Hosted API doesn't allow customer-managed keys for PHI workloads — can offer a partner-managed CMK but it's not BYOK.

ellie_sales: They're asking about SLA and pricing for Dedicated — rough ballpark for 2xA100 monthly reserved? Also want to run a 2-week canary at 5% traffic.

jordan_se: Ballpark reserved cost ~ $35k-$45k/mo for 2xA100 depending on region + serving license. Canary routing is trivial: route policy `canary=merlin-catalyst-quant` and set weight 5%. We'll need a rollout plan though.

mira_ml: Quantization note: v1-quant likely uses packed 4-bit kernels. Our runtime supports q4_0/q8 variants but only if model uses our packing layout. If they used a different quantizer we'll need to re-pack or run a converter. Request: small model sample or conversion script.

ellie_sales: They reported ~200ms median on their infra for short prompts. They want <300ms L95 for 512 tokens — doable?

tomas_ops: That's achievable on Dedicated with low batching and preferred kernel selection. Need to validate memory/KV behavior; quant variants can spike memory at startup for KV layout. Can someone run a local smoke with seq=512 and capture logs?

jordan_se: I'll run a local smoke. Can you give a sample payload? Example curl: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/engines/merlin-catalyst/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"input":"Summarize: The quick brown fox...","max_tokens":512}'```

ellie_sales: Also customer sent a security questionnaire. Q: Do we support SSO + SCIM provisioning for enterprise? They need SCIM for user sync and audit logs.

tomas_ops: Yes: Dedicated/Private support SSO + SCIM. Hosted supports SAML SSO and audit logs; SCIM provisioning is available on Enterprise plans. For questionnaire items we'll route to Legal for sign-off on data residency and encryption sections.

deploy-bot: Ticket INF-1427 created: "merlin-catalyst preflight validations" — assigned to jordan_se and mira_ml.

mira_ml: Jordan — when you run the smoke, please grep for KV metrics and paste top lines: `grep kv_size /tmp/merlin-smoke.log | sort -nr | head -n 10`. Also capture `tail -n 200 /tmp/merlin-smoke.log` if there's a kernel fallback.

jordan_se: On it. ETA ~2h. Quick note: we'll need tokenizer.json, config.json, and a <2MB weights sample (even mocked) to reproduce quant packing issues. Ask customer to upload to our secure share or drop to s3 presigned URL.

ellie_sales: I'll request `tokenizer.json`, `config.json`, and a small `weights.tar` plus confirmation on BYOK requirement. Also requesting completed sec questionnaire PDF. I'll ping Legal once I have docs.

tomas_ops: :thumbsup:

ellie_sales: Thanks team — circling back to customer with checklist and expected timeline (preflight + smoke in 4 hours). Will update thread when they respond.
